title: Zehra ke bain the ye payambar utho utho
body:
ZEHRA KE BAIN THE YE PAYAMBER UTHO UTHO
DEEN-E-KHUDA KE HADI-O-RAHBER UTHO UTHO
Baba tumhari yaad mein tukde jigar hai aaj
Dil beqaraar hai mera dumbhar utho utho
<<DIVIDER>>
Bechain dil hai paas bula lijiye mujhe
Ab zeest meri hogayi doobhar utho utho
Hasnain roke kehte hain nana kaha gaye
Bachcho ko mai manau to kyunkar utho utho
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab pachhade khaati hain Kulsoom rothi hain
Furqat mein sab hain apki muztar utho utho
Qabr-e-Rasool-e-Pak pe Zehra ke the ye bain
Rone nahi ye dete sitamgar utho utho
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehlu mera shikasta kiya ghar jala diya
Jaaun kahan mai bachcho ko lekar utho utho
Ghurbat me sar se Saaya-e-Rehmath jo uth gaya
Qasim bhi keh raha hai ye rokar utho utho
